summary.title: 2026–27 season to date · 8 games graded
summary.note: Graded the way the model grades itself: straight up is the side given over 50%; log loss and Brier score the win probability (lower is better); totals compare the expected goals in the final score (OT/SO winner +1) with the actual total. O/U leans are the side of 5.5 / 6.5 the model gives over 50%. Backtest, 2022–23 to 2025–26: 58.5% straight up, log loss 0.667, Brier 0.237, totals MAE 1.84.
